verdict.rationale: Lambda itself only exposes a REST API and cloud-init based provisioning with no native natural-language interface; the only evidence of NL-style operation is a third-party, unofficial CLI/MCP server built by a community member that lets agents issue commands like 'launch an H100, ssh in, run big_job.py'. This is not a first-party capability, so support is thin and indirect. missing for 10: official Lambda-built natural-language or chat interface, first-party MCP/agent server, documentation of NL command support.
